🌙 NIGHT SHIFT UPDATE
28 new night tasks are here! Rescue a lost puppy, spot the real boss, and earn Gems for completing tasks. Can you make it to sunrise?

🍫 Sell chocolate. Sounds easy… until something feels off.

👀 Keep your eyes open for anomalies.
💰 Make your next sale.
😨 Hope your next customer is normal.

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like!
🐛 Found a bug? Let us know on our community server.
